title: The Kindled Brow Discipline
summary: The school course in gathering light at the brow and loosing it as a beam; it ends in the school's gaze that burns where it rests.

title: Manual of the Mending Dawn
summary: The school manual of dawn light that mends and cleanses; its last lesson is the school's wide mercy for a whole company of wounded.

title: The Court of Prisms Discipline
summary: The school discipline of splitting the field into seven coloured beams that strike from seven angles and meet on one target.

title: The Radiant Core Canon
summary: The school canon of the formed Core burning as a small star whose light the student gathers and spends in one great stroke.

title: Manual of the Sworn Ray
summary: The school manual of a ray held to its bearing: a student who has sworn to a mark does not let the ray swerve from it.

title: The Far Beam Discipline
summary: The school discipline of beams loosed over great distance with strides to match; it ends in the school's unbroken line of light.

title: The Open Field Discipline
summary: The school discipline of the qi field spread as a plain of light in which the student sees all and is hidden from none.

title: The Beacon Core Canon
summary: The school canon of the formed Core raised as a standing beacon that guides allies and burns the foe that dares come near.
